description: Create a reusable hosted checkout — think product-page-style link that can be paid multiple times. Good for evergreen SKUs and donation pages.

local_price.description: Fiat-denominated price. Required when pricing_type is fixed_price.

pricing_type.description: fixed_price: exact amount in local_price. no_price: buyer chooses.

requested_info.description: Buyer fields Coinbase should collect on the hosted page (e.g. ["name", "email"])

name: create_checkout
